_comment: The Reading Room CATALOG. This is the 'add a doc' surface: append an entry when a document should join your reading queue, remove one once you've long finished with it. Word counts are NOT stored here -- the build script recomputes them live from the file at `path` every run, so they never go stale. Per-doc READ STATE (keep/done/del) is NOT stored here either -- that lives in the published artifact's `db` capability (collection `docs`, doc id = this entry's `id`). See SKILL.md for the schema and the (re)publish procedure.
